FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A44
To enter an angle or perpendicular space, choose the space, check traffic and signal before moving in slowly. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A44
Steer into the chosen space, center the vehicle, move to its front, then stop and secure it. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec12-R03 | anchor: A44
Before backing out of an angle or perpendicular space, check traffic in every direction and keep checking as the vehicle moves straight back. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec12-R04 | anchor: A44
Continue straight back until the front bumper clears the adjacent parked vehicle before steering sharply toward the intended rearward path. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec12-R05 | anchor: A44
After clearing the parking space, stop, select Drive and accelerate smoothly while straightening the wheels. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec12-R06 | anchor: A44
While parallel parking, observe surrounding traffic, pedestrians and fixed objects throughout the maneuver. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec12-R07 | anchor: A44
Begin parallel parking by checking rear traffic, slowing and signaling, then stop level with the vehicle ahead about 2 feet away. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec12-R08 | anchor: A44
Turn right and back slowly toward the vehicle behind; when the front door passes the forward vehicle’s rear bumper, straighten and continue backing. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec12-R09 | anchor: A44
Once clear of the vehicle ahead, steer sharply left while backing slowly and watch the sidewalk and vehicle behind. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec12-R10 | anchor: A44
Finish parallel parking by steering right toward the space center and straightening the wheels unless parked on a hill. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec12-R11 | anchor: A44
The final parallel-parked position should be within 12 inches of the curb or road edge and at least 2 feet from the parked vehicles. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec12-R12 | anchor: A44
To leave a parking space, signal and check mirrors and blind spots before pulling into traffic when safe. [A44]
Source: [A44 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0044]
